title: TriageDecision
description: Output of the Amin triage controller. Version stored on every decision (row 14).

prompt_version.description: Opaque string identifying the prompt template used.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code detected in the message body.

confidence.description: Model confidence; below threshold routes to Supervisor (row 8).

rule_hit.description: Name of the rule that fired, or null if a model call was made.

decision_hash.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hex of (tenant_rules, subject_normalized, rule_hit, action). Same input always produces the same hash (row 14).
